blogs.title: One Month With Claude Code
blogs.excerpt: What I've been building, why I started using Claude Code, and what I learned in my first month with it.
blogs.content:
after a long gap i came back :) honestly during the gap i didnt do much. some vacations, holidays and final week in my university whatever lets move to our topic what i did during the gap for my blog

first i started a big project i will tell you my app idea later it needs a time to mention for now i just tell you i started developing i am developing the project with claude code but i need to mention before the details i should mention why i started to learn claude code or what pushed me to learn it. no worries its not gonna take long time

as you know guys wc is running now and 3 days before the tournament started we decided to create a web app for wc prediction game we are playing with our friends everyone can create room with their friends group or compete with all users basically every match you predict the score or outcome and if you guess right you get points same as group orders and tournament first 8 team after you can see how many points you got and your friends as well we are already 180 people in the community rn we will make it for other tournaments too if you want to check this out i am adding the website link(https://wekisspicks.com) you can look up and tell me what should i add or how we can improve it

so how we got here yes we had quite short time and we needed to finish and publish as soon as possible and we decided to develop it with lovable.ai it was quite nice it has a lots of pros like hosting, auth system and solving problems etc. but for me i would like to see what i am doing and be part of the project so claude code is nice way to develop a project after i have seen many tutorials and courses from anthropic and youtube i am gonna share some what i learnt from courses and what is the differs from other llms and agents

1- so if I need to tell you my favourite feature about claude code It would be definitely claude code working on cli its really simple and useful with shortcuts and it works on your project directory as you can guess it sees your code files and what you are doing so it makes really easy yes I know cursor or copilot sees as well but it is still good feature :) and skills are so useful I experienced council for deciding something you know when you ask a question to llm’s it gives you typical messages and it always supports your idea or movements its really annoying but council makes it more objective with five different judging perspectives and gives you all of the perspectives or frontend skills it makes it really humanize your website design if you dont use it as you know all ai models make same ui theme and these days users can understand the website made with basic ai and they would think boring and classic about the website so it makes your website unique and special for you

2- you can personalize your claude according to your preferences and memorize it if you edit your claude.md file once and tell for example i dont want you to make changes without asking me first it memorizes and ask for each changes also you can create claude.md file for each project as well it's the same logic but just for specific to project its quite useful when you start a project with different teams

3- agents mode is useful and make faster but it consumes more tokens I cant say I use a lot but sometimes when I need a research I gave each agent different questions and check different responses it makes more faster but as I told you it can be expensive

And if we come to how to use it I always use claude code in English otherwise it consumes 30% more tokens if you use it in different languages also I try to explain my prompts very detailed I swear it works more than you think I always compact my context window when it gets higher than 40% also I clear when I move to new project or task

So I shared my experiences for 1 month with claude code I hope you think its helpful and valuable see you in the next blog post

blogs.content:

First of all, I would love to start to tell what I am doing here. In this blog website, I am gonna write about my experiences while I explore or learn new things.

Purpose of the blog, I mean what’s my expectations from that blog, make it permanent and clear when I learn or explore new things. With that, share you what I faced during the project or in the journey.

But I need to tell you, I am just a student, so please don’t expect too much :)))

I hope we will have fun together, improve ourselves, and with that learn new stuff. See you as soon as possible.
